title: Sample Collection and eDNA Extraction from Sterivex Filter Units
author: Oscar E Chiang
materials: A Sterivex filter unit (0.22 µm pore size) is attached to the suction hose by a stainless steel male Luer-lock ring hose barb (1/4'). We recommend using a hose clip (9-10 mm; Buerkle cat. no. BURK8678-000) to firmly tight the Luer-lock ring to the hose. Each filter can process up to 2L of water depending on the amount of the suspended material.

Allow mixing in a vortex with a horizontal adapter (Qiagen, Cat. No. 13000-V1-5) for 00:05:00 at the minimum speed. Set the filters with the inlet facing out and check for potential leakage from the outlet sealed with Parafilm.

steps.title: Prepare Equipment and Reagents
steps.instruction: Set up the laboratory environment and pre-heat reagents.

substeps.instruction: Disinfect surfaces and pipettes.
Turn on and set the waterbath to 65°C, oven to 90°C, and heating block to 37°C.
Incubate MBL solution in the waterbath at 65°C for 10 minutes.
Attach the vortex adapter to the vortexer.

steps.title: Collect Water Samples
steps.instruction: Filter water samples using a portable peristaltic pump (Vampire sampler; Buerkle) at a flow rate of approximately 30-50 mL/min.

substeps.instruction: Use a suction hose (Marprene; 4.8 mm inner diameter) connected to a flexible silicone hose via a suitable adapter.

steps.title: Prepare Sterivex Units for Extraction
steps.instruction: Remove excess liquid and seal the filter units.

substeps.instruction: Remove remaining liquid from the Sterivex unit using a 5 mL sterilized syringe by pushing air.
Cap both ends of the Sterivex; use Parafilm for male tip outlets to ensure it is dried and well sealed.
Identify samples by writing ID, date, replicate number, filtered volume, and station on the filter and sample bags.
Store samples at -20°C if not processed immediately.

steps.title: Initial Buffer Addition and Mixing
steps.instruction: Add ST1B buffer and vortex the samples.

substeps.instruction: Place Sterivex vertically (inlet cap upward) and slowly load 900 µL of ST1B buffer (stored at 4°C).
Rotate Sterivex 90 degrees and vortex at minimum speed for 5 minutes.
Repeat the buffer addition and vortexing steps 3 more times (total of 4 cycles of 900 µL buffer and 5 min vortexing).

steps.title: Lysis and Incubation
steps.instruction: Apply lysis solution and heat the samples.

substeps.instruction: Slowly add 900 µL of MBL solution (pre-heated at 65°C for 10 minutes).
Incubate filter units vertically (inlet upward) at 90°C for 5 minutes in an oven, checking Parafilm for leaks before and after.

steps.title: Cooling and Final Mixing
steps.instruction: Cool the samples and perform high-speed mixing.

substeps.instruction: Cool filters at room temperature for 2 minutes.
Re-tighten caps and check Parafilm.
Vortex at maximum speed for 5 minutes (lower speed if filters do not stay in place).

steps.title: Recover Lysate
steps.instruction: Extract the lysate from the Sterivex unit into a tube.

substeps.instruction: Transfer lysate to a 3-5 mL syringe by pushing 1 mL of air into the vertical filter and releasing the plunger to pull back the lysate.
Pour lysate into a 5 mL Powerbeat tube and vortex horizontally at maximum speed for 5 minutes.
Centrifuge the tube at 4000 x g for 1 minute.

steps.title: RNA Removal and Precipitation
steps.instruction: Treat the lysate to remove RNA and precipitate DNA.

substeps.instruction: Transfer lysate to a clean 2.2 mL collection tube.
Add 1.6 µL of RNAse (final concentration 100 mg/mL) and incubate at 37°C for 30 minutes in a heating block or water bath.
While incubating, pre-heat MR solution to 65°C and prepare the VacValve vacuum system connected to a vacuum pump.
Add 300 µL IRS solution to the tube, vortex, and incubate at 4°C for 5 minutes.
Centrifuge the tube at 13000 x g for 1 minute.

steps.title: DNA Binding
steps.instruction: Bind the DNA to a spin column using MR solution.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the supernatant to a 5 mL collection tube (avoiding the pellet).
Add 3 mL of MR solution (pre-heated at 65°C for 10 minutes) and vortex.
Load the 4.5 mL supernatant into a tube extender and MB spin column.
Filtrate at low pressure using the VacValve vacuum system with an adapter.

steps.title: Wash and Dry Spin Column
steps.instruction: Wash the bound DNA and dry the membrane.

substeps.instruction: Remove the column extender.
Wash the spin column with 800 µL of ethanol (keep columns open).
Shake PW solution and wash the spin column with 800 µL of PW solution (keep columns open).
Dry the membrane by running the vacuum pump for 1 minute.
Wash again with 800 µL of ethanol and dry the membrane for 1 minute via vacuum.
Close lids, turn off the vacuum pump, and open one port to release vacuum.

steps.title: Elute DNA
steps.instruction: Elute the purified DNA from the column.

substeps.instruction: Place the spin column in a clean collection tube and centrifuge at 13000 x g for 2 minutes to dry.
Transfer the spin column to a new 1.5 mL safe-lock collection tube.
Add 50-100 µL of solution EB (or DNA-free grade water).
Centrifuge at 13000 x g for 1 minute.
Transfer the eluate back onto the column and centrifuge a second time at 13000 x g for 1 minute.

steps.title: Quantify and Store DNA
steps.instruction: Check DNA quality and store the final product.

substeps.instruction: Check DNA purity using a Nanodrop (1 µL of blank or sample).
Quantify DNA concentration using Qubit following the manufacturer's instructions.
Store DNA samples at -20°C.
